title: Set up your workspace
intro: Four short steps. You can leave and come back — your progress is saved.

organization.name: Organization
organization.title: Name your organization
organization.body: This is the workspace your team and clients will see.

template.name: Starting template
template.title: Pick a starting point
template.body: Templates add milestones and a few starter tasks to your first project. You can change everything later.

teammates.name: Teammates
teammates.title: Invite your team
teammates.body: Invitations are emailed and expire after 7 days. You can skip this and invite people later from Settings.

project.name: First project
project.title: Create your first project
project.body: Projects hold tasks, documents, files, requests and approvals.
